# Contexted

A peer-matching experiment that connects people through shared context — the recurring themes, tone, and texture of how they think — read from their AI assistant memory (ChatGPT, Claude).

## What it does
- Users share their AI assistant's memory/context summary
- Contexted analyzes communication patterns, values, curiosities, anxieties
- Matches happen in scheduled batched drops
- Each match surfaces shared synergy points and a mutual prompt
- Anonymous chat opens once both sides answer the prompt
- Invite-only with a referral loop earning earlier consideration in future drops

## Core thesis
Photos are a poor predictor of whether two people will keep talking. Shared context — values, communication style, the way someone holds a question — is closer to the thing.

## Brand
Warm, literate, tech-native. No photos, no swipes. "Words over faces."
